findings.magnitudes_hist: Mean magnitude is 4.36, median 4.40; 15.5% of events are below M4 and only 1.1% are M6 or stronger (max M7.7). Skewness is -0.15; the histogram may mix two groups (small local events and M4-5 global events), which is related to the 2.5 magnitude threshold and to different networks.
findings.magnitude_depth_scatter: Correlation between magnitude and depth is -0.01, so depth hardly explains magnitude. Events deeper than 300 km are 5.5% of the data; most earthquakes are shallow.
findings.top_regions_bar: The most active region is Vanuatu (290 events). The top 10 regions give 60.6% of all earthquakes, so activity is concentrated in a few seismic belts.
findings.earthquakes_by_day_line: On average 63.6 earthquakes per day. The peak day is 2026-10-24 with 147 events, the quietest has 40. A peak day may be linked to a strong earthquake and its aftershocks.
findings.correlation_heatmap: The strongest relation is between mag and sig (r = 0.94); correlation of mag with depth_km is -0.01.
